invariants.title: Money is integer cents; a payment's principal, interest and escrow add up to its row exactly.
A loan starts from the lender's figures with their source; a payment that cannot cover a month's interest is refused.
A linked row is in the books once: principal off what is owed, interest and escrow as spending, paid from its account.
The lender's printed split is the record; a split by the schedule says so.
What is owed is the lender's figure less the principal paid since; a difference with the lender's later figure is named.
Every write is a logged command with an actor; refusals are logged too.
